title: Whistleblower Submission: Shea, The Angels, Moreno and Roundtree (May 23, 2022 Transmission)

transmission_metadata.subject: Shea, The Angels, Moreno and Roundtree

primary_source_text:
Send me an Angel

Shea, Moreno, and Roundtree have been going into “ventures” together for a long time now.

After Shea’s Managers tried running into my home last year and harassing me, it wasn’t too hard to find their connections to the Anaheim Angels sale.

I tried very hard to let the Shea Managers know after they broke FEDERAL LAWS on April 23rd 2021, that I was a very busy man and had no time to pursue them, according to the RENTAL RELIEF LAWS and have Shea’s massive company looked into from every angle. Including for VIOLATING CIVIL RIGHTS LAWS AND DISCRIMINATION LAWS. Also FRAUD for trying to mislead me.

I didn’t immediately hear from Shea after my request for them to fix this, so I didn’t open a federal complaint, or civil rights complaint, BUT I STILL DID MY OWN INVESTIGATION.

IT TOOK LESS THAN A WEEK TO CROSS REFERENCE THEIR PUBLIC FILINGS FOR VENTURES AND INVESTMENTS.

CLEARLY THE MOST CURRENT CONNECTION AND ISSUE WAS: THE ANAHEIM ANGELS SCANDAL

After Shea and the same cronies involved with Anaheims greedy scum set my family and I up. They wanted to make sure I couldn’t put the Federal Spotlight on them bc The Angels deal would easily get pulled in. Clearly by me.

Now, Shea and The Cabal potentially committed a “lying in wait” crime, but they definitely premeditated a crime using a violent and retaliatory eviction against me and my family.

July 1 through 12th, Irvine officials told myself and my disabled mom that the scheduled lockout and eviction on July 12th would not happen bc I was in the rental RELEIF program, and the federal laws prohibited the eviction bc SHEA WAS GOING TO GET PAID THE RENT FROM THE RENTAL RELIEF. And that I could stay with my son and my mom in our Shea Apt Home until the end of my lease in less than 70 days. Then I could move.

On July 12th, the eviction/lockout didn’t happen. I didn’t believe them, thank God.

And what I had to do to protect my son and my mom since July 12th until now, I’m going to save for Hollywood.

And just like clockwork, on Aug 4th, without warning, Shea had a violent and incredibly dangerous hit carried out on me and my family.

I wasn’t prepared 100% personally, I already made sure my son and mom were, but I almost had someone killed that needed my help as an IHSS Caregiver but privately. Which I have done many times in my life, for free, for my soul as a human with the knowledge to help and the passion to care. IHSS made me a caregiver out of demand and request, not bc I knew or pursued it.

They almost killed me and my high profile patient staying with me.

I have barely seen my son Since last May and my disabled mother is still in Mexico after I had to pull her from her treatments at Hoag in Newport...
